sections.criterion: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

consistency_log.description: Objective consistency across Excellence and Implementation sections, cross-checked against Tier 3 objectives.json
Work-package reference consistency: WP IDs cited in Excellence (methodology) and Impact (pathway grounding) match the canonical WP1-WP5 list defined in Implementation wp_table_refs
consistency_log.source_basis: Section wp_table_refs (Implementation), WP titles cross-read from Excellence 1.1/1.2 and Impact 2.2; canonical WP structure Tier 4 phase3_wp_design

consistency_log.description: Partner name consistency across all three sections, cross-checked against Tier 3 partners.json legal_name/short_name (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR, fellow, supervisors)
Deliverable ID and title consistency for D1.1-D5.5 across Excellence, Impact and Implementation, including due months
consistency_log.source_basis: Deliverable enumerations in Excellence 1.1, Impact 2.2/2.3 and Implementation 3.1; canonical deliverable titles/months Tier 4 phase8 canonical_reference_pack

consistency_log.description: Milestone ID consistency between Impact (pathway references) and Implementation (milestone_refs MS1-MS6)
consistency_log.source_basis: Implementation milestone_refs MS1-MS6 and MS1(M6)/MS2(M12)/MS3(M16)/MS4(M20)/MS5(M23)/MS6(M30) definitions; Impact carries no conflicting milestone IDs

consistency_log.description: KPI consistency: KPIs K1-K11 referenced across Impact sub-sections 2.2 and 2.3 use consistent identifiers and target descriptions; Implementation does not restate KPI targets
consistency_log.source_basis: Impact 2.2/2.3 KPI references K1-K11; Tier 3 impacts.json KPI definitions

consistency_log.description: Impact claim grounding: every deliverable/WP cited by an Impact claim (D2.2, D3.2, D4.2, D4.3, D5.1, D5.3, D5.4, D5.5; WP2-WP5) exists in the Implementation work plan
Budget/resource claim consistency: person-month figures (fellow 30.0 PM; supervisor 2.5; co-supervisor 2.0; AgroVIR 3.0 in-kind) stated in Excellence 1.3 match Implementation 3.1 effort allocation
consistency_log.source_basis: Excellence 1.3 in-kind supervisory PM figures; Implementation 3.1 effort table and partner in-kind estimates; Tier 3 working_assumptions.json (declared assumed PM values)

consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency for key technical terms (validation ladder, Field Decision Value/FDV, hyperspectral-to-Sentinel transfer, DrR - Digital Agronomist, processing tomato, leakage-safe validation) across all three sections
consistency_log.source_basis: Cross-section reading of canonical component/system names against Tier 3 objective titles and concept vocabulary

consistency_log.description: Section ordering and completeness: Excellence (1), Impact (2), Implementation (3) all present and in the MSCA-PF Part B criterion order
consistency_log.source_basis: Three section artifacts present with criterion fields; MSCA-PF Part B ordering from tier2a application_forms (msca af_he-msca-pf)

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency: each section has a non-empty traceability_footer.primary_sources and no_unsupported_claims_declaration consistent with validation_status.overall_status (none unresolved)

Validation status aggregation (informational): all three sections report validation_status.overall_status = 'assumed', reflecting declared working assumptions (placement-host details, partner in-kind person-months) rather than unresolved contradictions; flagged for downstream review

traceability_footer.derivation_note: Assembled draft inherits section-level proposal claim traceability from referenced section artifacts; this artifact adds only section index and cross-section consistency findings.
